Job Title: Fall 2026 Co-op: Visual Designer (8 months)
Company Name: CGI
Location: Toronto, ON, CA
Date Posted: 2026-06-29
Job Type: intern
Remote: yes
Salary: $18
Job URL: https://indeed.njoyn.com/corp/xweb/XWeb.asp?page=jobdetails&clid=21001&JobID=J0626-0622&BRID=1312536&sbdid=936
Source: indeed
Job Description: CGI is seeking a Visual Designer to help market new and existing services for our Global Technology Operations Business Unit. You will work closely with Service Owners, Alliance Managers, Senior Leadership and other key stakeholders to assist in taking our services and offerings to market. Once a solution, a service or alliance has been designed/created, you will participate in creating the marketing, communications and sales collateral to get the products and services into the market.
  

  

Our ideal Visual Designer leads with client centric design thinking and thinks about service or product marketing as an end\-to\-end process. The ideal candidate will have digital design experience and sales enablement experience to participate in the creation of the sales collateral and underlying strategies that will help our client facing sales teams learn how to sell/position and articulate the value proposition of our services.
  

  

Are you motivated by the opportunity to delight our sales teams by providing them with marketing material that visually articulates how CGI's services solve complex technical and business challenges for their clients? If this resonates with you, as well as the opportunity to learn, develop and grow in a global professional services firm \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

Perks of being a CGI Co\-op:  

  

The co\-op program was designed to help students improve their skills and explore their professional interests through hands\-on experience and professional guidance, while also helping them develop core competencies. As an intern, you have access to:  

  

* Professional development sessions
* Professional development platform
* Networking events with colleagues and leaders
* Mentorship from leaders and colleagues aimed at setting and achieving your career goals

  

Start Date: September 2026  

Application Deadline: July 5th, 2026  

  

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $18\-32/hour. This role is an existing vacancy.**Your future duties and responsibilities**


As a Visual Designer you will be working on the development of service marketing and sales enablement collateral. You’ll support all aspects of Service Marketing, as well as be a key contributor to our sales and marketing collateral design activities. Your responsibilities will include:
  

  

* Develop and design sales and marketing assets for service offerings
* Develop visualizations/graphics to articulate our service value propositions and overall strategy
* Create and design infographics
* Create and design of elements for PowerPoint presentations
* Collaborate with our business strategists to understand user and business needs, identify design opportunities, and create meaningful buying experiences
**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Essential Qualifications \& Proficiency with the following tools:  

* Adobe Creative Cloud
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Illustrator
* WordPress
* Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint \& Word)
* Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)


  

Desired Qualifications:  

* 2\+ years' experience in digital design
* 1\+ years creating marketing collateral
* 2\+ years' experience user\-centered design processes


  

Professional Attributes:  

* Ability to learn quickly
* Self\-starter who can work with and facilitate Subject Matter Experts
* Independent thinker, not afraid to share their Point of View and perspectives
* Willingness to learn new skills, and grow


  

Education and Certification:  

* Progressing towards Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a creative/digital discipline

  

\#LI\-LP9**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  

  

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal\-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.

description: CGI is seeking a Visual Designer to help market new and existing services for our Global Technology Operations Business Unit. You will work closely with Service Owners, Alliance Managers, Senior Leadership and other key stakeholders to assist in taking our services and offerings to market. Once a solution, a service or alliance has been designed/created, you will participate in creating the marketing, communications and sales collateral to get the products and services into the market.
  

  

Our ideal Visual Designer leads with client centric design thinking and thinks about service or product marketing as an end\-to\-end process. The ideal candidate will have digital design experience and sales enablement experience to participate in the creation of the sales collateral and underlying strategies that will help our client facing sales teams learn how to sell/position and articulate the value proposition of our services.
  

  

Are you motivated by the opportunity to delight our sales teams by providing them with marketing material that visually articulates how CGI's services solve complex technical and business challenges for their clients? If this resonates with you, as well as the opportunity to learn, develop and grow in a global professional services firm \- we'd love to hear from you.  

  

Perks of being a CGI Co\-op:  

  

The co\-op program was designed to help students improve their skills and explore their professional interests through hands\-on experience and professional guidance, while also helping them develop core competencies. As an intern, you have access to:  

  

* Professional development sessions
* Professional development platform
* Networking events with colleagues and leaders
* Mentorship from leaders and colleagues aimed at setting and achieving your career goals

  

Start Date: September 2026  

Application Deadline: July 5th, 2026  

  

CGI is providing a reasonable estimate of the pay range for this role. The determination of this range includes factors such as skill set level, geographic market, experience and training, and licenses and certifications. Compensation decisions depend on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $18\-32/hour. This role is an existing vacancy.**Your future duties and responsibilities**


As a Visual Designer you will be working on the development of service marketing and sales enablement collateral. You’ll support all aspects of Service Marketing, as well as be a key contributor to our sales and marketing collateral design activities. Your responsibilities will include:
  

  

* Develop and design sales and marketing assets for service offerings
* Develop visualizations/graphics to articulate our service value propositions and overall strategy
* Create and design infographics
* Create and design of elements for PowerPoint presentations
* Collaborate with our business strategists to understand user and business needs, identify design opportunities, and create meaningful buying experiences
**Required qualifications to be successful in this role**


Essential Qualifications \& Proficiency with the following tools:  

* Adobe Creative Cloud
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Illustrator
* WordPress
* Microsoft 365 (PowerPoint \& Word)
* Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)


  

Desired Qualifications:  

* 2\+ years' experience in digital design
* 1\+ years creating marketing collateral
* 2\+ years' experience user\-centered design processes


  

Professional Attributes:  

* Ability to learn quickly
* Self\-starter who can work with and facilitate Subject Matter Experts
* Independent thinker, not afraid to share their Point of View and perspectives
* Willingness to learn new skills, and grow


  

Education and Certification:  

* Progressing towards Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a creative/digital discipline

  

\#LI\-LP9**Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.**  

  

Life at CGI is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because…  

  

You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction.  

  

Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise.  

  

You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well\-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons.  

  

At CGI, we value the strength that diversity brings and are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone belongs. We collaborate with our clients to build more inclusive communities and empower all CGI partners to thrive. As an equal\-opportunity employer, being able to perform your best during the recruitment process is important to us. If you require an accommodation, please inform your recruiter.  

  

That same commitment to fairness extends to how we use technology. To support our recruitment team, AI tools may be used to help assess applications though they never replace human judgement. All hiring decisions remain entirely in the hands of our recruitment professionals.  

  

To learn more about accessibility at CGI, contact us via email. Please note that this email is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used for application status inquiries.  

  

Come join our team—one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world.
